questions.question: The quotation in the author’s post gives 1914 as the year Menshov entered Moscow University. The university biography and his 90th-birthday article give autumn 1912. Please check the quotation’s source and decide whether the year of entry should be distinguished from the seminar’s beginning. The source’s 1914 is retained in both languages.

Университетская биография https://new.math.msu.su/tffa/memory/menshov.html и статья к его 90-летию https://www.mathnet.ru/links/096d28cde628169d3eebd24f457503eb/rm3934.pdf указывают осень 1912 года. questions.resolution: The retelling retains 1914 as printed in Kvant (no. 4, 1996, p. 24: https://www.kvant.digital/issues/1996/4/tihomirov-o_matematikah_s_ulyibkoy-7a0fd755/). A note distinguishes Menshov’s actual enrolment in autumn 1912, as stated in his own recollections (https://www.mat.univie.ac.at/~neretin/misc/luzin/menshov.html), from the start of the seminar in 1914.
